messages:
PagerBot: [P1] GPU POOL DEGRADATION eu-west-1
PagerBot: 58% of hosts in gpu-eu-west-1 showing HEALTH=Degraded and enqueue latency > 2.5s for hosted-gen and dedicated-eu. Alert ALRT-2026-1759924678

jen: digging in. seeing nvlink/reset IEs and several driver restarts in az-a.

mike: we have BGP flaps on rack-5 and rack-6, fabric counters spiking. suspected L2/L3 instability.

arthur: runtime traces include KV cache thrashing, some long-lived sessions pinned to bad hosts.

priya: i'm oncall for next 90m, will coordinate. handing paging policy tweak if needed.

lisa: Support: a handful of enterprise Dedicated customers report 504s. advising them we are working on mitigation.

mike: proposal: do a canary reroute 15% to eu-north-1 and eu-west-2, cordon problematic hosts, drain sessions >20m. monitor.

jen: agree. canary window 6m. i'll run route shift for hosted-gen first.

jen: ```
redwoodctl traffic shift --from eu-west-1 --to eu-north-1 --route hosted-gen --percent 15 --method gradual
redwoodctl traffic shift --from eu-west-1 --to eu-west-2 --route dedicated-eu --percent 15 --method gradual
```

OpsBot: Executing shifts: hosted-gen -> eu-north-1 (15%), dedicated-eu -> eu-west-2 (15%). Auto-rollback: enabled if err_rate > 3% for 3m.

arthur: warning: moving traffic will cold-start KV caches in targets. suggest pre-warm job for top prompt sets.

jen: launching warm job: `infra-warm --regions eu-north-1,eu-west-2 --keys top10`.

priya: lowering automated pager sensitivity for transient spikes in eu-west for 30m to avoid noisy pages.

mike: draining nodes now. `kubectl -n inference drain gpu-eu-west-1-node-5 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` -- evicting sessions older than 20m.

lisa: Finance note: short-term routing to other regions will increase egress/on-demand GPU cost ~12-18% while canary runs. approved for up to 3h.

OpsBot: Shift progress: hosted-gen 15% -> eu-north-1 (complete), dedicated-eu 15% -> eu-west-2 (complete). Monitoring metrics.

jen: metrics look stable: p95 tokens +0.3s, errors 0.9%. proceed to 50% if stable at 9m.

arthur: fabric team applying BGP holdtime tweak to racks 5/6. will watch for reduction in flaps.

mike: patched driver on 3 hosts that showed nvlink OOM. health checks passing.

OpsBot: Route shift progress: hosted-gen 50% -> eu-north-1. No rollback triggers.

priya: handoff: I'll create incident ticket INC-2026-8791, include timeline, cost note, commands, and assign RCA owners: ENG-RUNTIME, ENG-FABRIC, ENG-PLATFORM.

jen: added follow-ups: ENG-RUNTIME: analyze nvlink resets + kernel logs; ENG-FABRIC: confirm BGP patch effect and rollback plan; ENG-PLATFORM: review temp paging threshold change and revert rules.

lisa: I've notified affected customers and support has pinned messaging. We'll send a short postmortem once RCA is ready.

arthur: taking on-call after priya in 1h if still open. will monitor KV warm completion and tail latency.

priya: containment achieved: canary successful, unhealthy hosts drained. keeping incident open for RCA and capacity remediation. tagging incident-1759924678. :white_check_mark:
